summary: Verified a genuine beta-precision parity correction on gfx950, including failing-before/passing-after and a 96-round independent recurrent transition test. This is only a partial fix: the original beta-aligned Qwen3.8 forced-rejection reproduction still has a reported later divergence, and the exact model/CUDA reproduction was unavailable.

tests.command: candidate test file with kernel source restored to base semantics: python -m pytest -q -s test/registered/kernels/ops/attention/test_fused_verify_triton_gdn.py -k target_verify_matches_packed_decode_beta_semantics
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before control: 2 of 4 beta cases failed bitwise packed-decode parity; b=-0.5 had 128/128 unequal BF16 outputs and max absolute difference 0.000244140625.
Candidate regression: all four beta values passed exact output and FP32 intermediate-state equality.
Independent 96-round randomized BF16 width-one transitions from a nonzero FP32 recurrent state; packed and verify outputs/states remained bitwise equal.
Full changed GDN kernel test file: 17 passed.
Adjacent non-contiguous GDN and KDA boundaries: 23 passed and 3 subtests passed.

gpu_evidence: Tests executed on assigned AMD Instinct MI355X, architecture gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, through PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2.
remaining_counterexamples: The original issue reports that with this same beta alignment, BF16 persistent-state forced rejection still diverges from Base at output index 23.
The original issue reports that beta alignment plus FP32 persistent SSM state still diverges from Base at output index 38 (Base token 6338 versus DSpark token 2279).
The exact Qwen3.8 target/draft model-level serving reproduction was not run, so the candidate is not independently verified against the full original workload.
remaining_limitations: The exact Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 and Qwen3.8-27B-DSpark weights were unavailable.
The available architecture was AMD gfx950/ROCm 7.2, not RTX 5090/CUDA 13/NVFP4.
The deterministic tiny Llama fixture is not a GDN/Qwen3.8 architecture fixture and was not used as substitute proof.
No native rebuild was applicable because the candidate changes only Triton/Python source.
